posts.title: Non-text AI model Jev valued at $7.5B weeks after launch
posts.excerpt: Andreessen Horowitz led the $870 million round, with Sequoia and existing investor DCVC joining, for a startup founded in 2024 by an ex-OpenAI researcher and a former Meta research engineer. Jev is a…
posts.body: Andreessen Horowitz led the $870 million round, with Sequoia and existing investor DCVC joining, for a startup founded in 2024 by an ex-OpenAI researcher and a former Meta research engineer. [Jev](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/09/the-maker-of-non-text-ai-model-jev-valued-at-7-5b-just-weeks-after-launch/) is a transformer aimed at automation: it skips words entirely and outputs probabilities, what TypeSafe calls calibrated decisions.

posts.title: Soft foods that keep protein up after the extraction
posts.excerpt: For the first 48 hours, keep it soft, lukewarm, and protein-forward: plain yogurt, scrambled eggs, silken tofu, mashed avocado, and blended lukewarm soups all qualify (Medical & Dental). Heat,…
posts.body: For the first 48 hours, keep it soft, lukewarm, and protein-forward: plain yogurt, scrambled eggs, silken tofu, mashed avocado, and blended lukewarm soups all qualify ([Medical & Dental](https://www.md.co.uk/blog/what-to-eat-first-48-hours-after-wisdom-tooth-surgery)). Heat, crunch, spice, seeds, and straws are what disturb the healing site, so they stay off the menu until it firms up ([Shoreline Dental](https://shorelinedentalcare.com/eating-after-wisdom-teeth-removal/)).

posts.title: Recovered Starship Ship 40 pulls into the Port of Brownsville
posts.excerpt: The 171-foot stage splashed down upright and intact in the Indian Ocean in July, the first Starship upper stage to survive a flight without exploding or sinking. Saltwater exposure likely ended its…
posts.body: The 171-foot stage [splashed down upright and intact in the Indian Ocean](https://www.caller.com/story/news/local/texas/2026/10/09/spacex-starship-ship-40-recovered-starbase-port/92167239007/) in July, the first Starship upper stage to survive a flight without exploding or sinking. Saltwater exposure likely ended its flying days, which is why SpaceX wants the stage back as a teardown to improve future vehicles.

posts.body: A Hurricane Warning is in effect from Ocean Springs, Mississippi, to the Bay/Gulf County line in Florida, and a Tornado Watch covers portions of Alabama, Florida and Georgia until 9 PM ([People](https://people.com/hurricane-isaias-category-3-hours-before-making-landfall-gulf-coast-12166534)). posts.title: Copilot's HydraFusion routing now in VS Code and the Copilot app
posts.excerpt: GitHub's September 30 release put the HydraFusion research preview in the Copilot model picker in VS Code and the Copilot app, routing each coding task through single, cascade, or cross-family…
posts.body: GitHub's September 30 release put the HydraFusion research preview in the Copilot model picker in VS Code and the Copilot app, routing each coding task through single, cascade, or cross-family critique workflows instead of one fixed model ([GitHub changelog](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-30-hydrafusion-in-vs-code-and-the-github-copilot-app/)). Its [offline benchmarks](https://gcn.com/coding-tool-now-used-million-developers/22170/) put the fused workflows 36 to 67 percent below Claude Opus 5 in estimated cost at matching quality.

posts.title: Beet juice added nothing to 12 weeks of lifting
posts.excerpt: A daily beetroot-juice habit added no extra strength or muscle over a nitrate-free placebo across twelve weeks of supervised lifting, per the European Journal of Applied Physiology trial (Men's…
posts.body: A daily beetroot-juice habit added no extra strength or muscle over a nitrate-free placebo across twelve weeks of supervised lifting, per the European Journal of Applied Physiology trial ([Men's Journal](https://www.mensjournal.com/health/researchers-added-beet-juice-to-strength-training-and-one-result-stood-out)). Muscle biopsies showed the lifting itself raised mitochondrial markers and improved most leg-extensor measures, so the juice keeps its endurance credentials and loses its lifting ones.

posts.body: The Norwegian Nobel Committee honored a career spent defending international law, from anti-apartheid courtrooms to the UN's Gaza inquiry ([USA Today](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2026/10/09/nobel-peace-prize-navanethem-navi-pillay/92166541007/)). The pick reads as a defense of the legal order itself, with committee chair Jørgen Watne Frydnes warning that the system is under tremendous pressure.

posts.body: A new unofficial tool for jailbroken PS5s called XENO TOOL now ships a built-in [game store](https://www.news9live.com/technology/gaming/ps5-jailbreak-unofficial-game-store-risks-3013261), updated to version 3.2.71 on October 3 with its developer claiming a browsable PS4 and PS5 catalogue. posts.title: Anne Carson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
posts.excerpt: The Swedish Academy picked the genre-blurring Canadian poet Anne Carson for the 2026 literature prize, praising what it called a "bold and inventive oeuvre" in playful dialogue with the classical…
posts.body: The Swedish Academy picked the genre-blurring Canadian poet Anne Carson for the 2026 literature prize, praising what it called a "bold and inventive oeuvre" in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, [per Reuters](https://www.lapost.com/content/canadian-poet-and-writer-anne-carson-wins-2026-nobel-prize-in-literature). Carson, 76, heard the news while in Iceland and told broadcaster RUV she would get a sticker on the front of her book.

posts.title: SSA ends flexible work schedules, union files grievance
posts.excerpt: The Social Security Administration told employees Monday that all alternative work schedules end November 16, moving everyone to a five-day week, per Government Executive. AFGE's SSA General…
posts.body: The Social Security Administration told employees Monday that all alternative work schedules end November 16, moving everyone to a five-day week, [per Government Executive](https://www.govexec.com/workforce/2026/10/social-security-ends-flexible-work-schedules/416480/). AFGE's SSA General Committee filed a national grievance, arguing the move illegally repudiates a union contract that runs through October 2029.

posts.title: $22.3B US-Korea power campus to feed South Texas data center
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 8, 2026, 4:10 PM: The U.S. Department of Commerce and the Republic of Korea announced Sept. 30 they will jointly develop Project Star, a $22.3 billion energy campus in Encinal, Texas,…
posts.body: Published Oct 8, 2026, 4:10 PM: The U.S. Department of Commerce and the Republic of Korea announced Sept. 30 they will jointly develop Project Star, a $22.3 billion energy campus in Encinal, Texas, built to feed an adjacent data center directly and send any excess power to the Texas grid ([NextEra Energy](https://www.investor.nexteraenergy.com/news-and-events/news-releases/2026/09-30-2026-231920318)). The campus is designed as the model for Abbott's bring-your-own-generation rule for Texas data centers, with the plant serving the data center first and the grid only seeing the surplus.

posts.title: Two-thirds of children reaching Europe traveled alone, UN says
posts.excerpt: More than 20,000 of the 31,100 children who reached Europe by Mediterranean and Balkan routes in 2025 were unaccompanied or separated (Reuters). Nearly half of the young people interviewed along…
posts.body: More than 20,000 of the 31,100 children who reached Europe by Mediterranean and Balkan routes in 2025 were unaccompanied or separated ([Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/world/more-unaccompanied-children-are-taking-dangerous-crossings-europe-un-says-2026-10-07/)). Nearly half of the young people interviewed along those routes reported physical violence in transit, with Libya most frequently named as the place where abuses occurred.

posts.title: AI-built GoldHEN copy sparks homebrew scene backlash
posts.excerpt: A homebrew developer going by Zer0Day used AI to reverse-engineer GoldHEN, the closed-source PS4 homebrew tool Sistro spent roughly five years building, and published the copy on GitHub while…
posts.body: A homebrew developer going by Zer0Day used AI to reverse-engineer GoldHEN, the closed-source PS4 homebrew tool Sistro spent roughly five years building, and published the copy on GitHub while brushing off the team's objections ([Kotaku](https://kotaku.com/ai-bro-defends-sloppily-reverse-engineering-playstation-homebrew-tool-without-permission-by-invoking-freedom-of-speech-2000741098)). Meanwhile the AI-generated glut keeps spreading: the PS5 emulators KytyPS5, SharpEmu and AnyPS5 now sit at roughly 1,840 GitHub forks, up from about 1,300 just three days earlier.

posts.body: The Decisions API takes text and images and returns one of three verdicts: a probability that a statement is true, a pick from preset options, or a score on a numeric range ([OpenAI's announcement](https://community.openai.com/t/decisions-api-is-now-available-in-public-beta/1403877)). It runs on GPT-6 Luna at $0.10 per million input tokens, with output, cache-read, and cache-write tokens all free.

posts.title: Bodyweight circuit before intervals slows runners
posts.excerpt: Sixteen recreational runners ran their 8x200m intervals slower after a bodyweight circuit than without it, with total time rising in both men and women (Sport Sciences for Health). The circuit was…
posts.body: Sixteen recreational runners ran their 8x200m intervals slower after a bodyweight circuit than without it, with total time rising in both men and women ([Sport Sciences for Health](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11332-026-01927-y)). The circuit was only three rounds of 15-second all-out jumps, lunges, sit-ups, and burpees.

posts.title: Kagan and Soai win Nobel chemistry prize for mirror-image molecules
posts.excerpt: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in chemistry Wednesday for their discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis, the chemistry that makes…
posts.body: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in chemistry Wednesday for their discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis, the chemistry that makes molecules form as just one of two mirror-image forms ([AP](https://www.wkyufm.org/news/2026-10-07/henri-b-kagan-and-kenso-soai-win-nobel-prize-in-chemistry)). The Nobel committee called their work decisive for chemists who design reactions for manufacturing pharmaceuticals.

posts.title: HHS to assign government lawyers to migrant kids' cases
posts.excerpt: A September 29 Federal Register notice signed by Secretary Kennedy places the new Unaccompanied Alien Children Legal Representation Division inside HHS's Office of General Counsel, authorizing its…
posts.body: A September 29 Federal Register notice signed by Secretary Kennedy places the new Unaccompanied Alien Children Legal Representation Division inside HHS's Office of General Counsel, authorizing its attorneys to advise children and enter appearances in immigration court ([September 29 notice](https://111things.com/national/hhs-creates-legal-division-for-unaccompanied-migrant-children/)). Legal-aid leaders [told the Associated Press](https://www.lapost.com/content/critics-decry-trump-administration-s-move-to-assign-government-lawyers-to-migrant-kids-cases) the setup fails basic standards for independent counsel, putting the children's lawyers inside the same department that holds them in custody.
